en.html:
The wind was howling. The rain came so hard and thick it might as well have been a sandstorm.

Our iron body, tossed about like a leaf. Left, right, dancing dangerously wherever those invisible hands wanted us.
Thunder also joined in, apparently concerned that the scene lacked accompaniment—

en.html:
My useless complaint, her unnecessary defense. We exchanged both. Not because we were so relaxed that we had time for this. Rather the opposite.

...Some slightly better time and place, please. If that was too much to ask, at least get us out of THIS one quickly.

A fine set of requests. Not one address to send them to. All I could do was turn them over in my head.
A warrior was king of the battlefield. The weather was not recognizing the monarchy.

Could the corrective force please start correcting?

en.html: I looked down. Only then did I realize: no land below us. Sea. The water was raging as badly as the sky. A ship, not a very large one, drifted on it.◆ A ship…………◆A ship? A ship, yes. But of what kind? I had never seen one shaped like that. More refined, more advanced in construction than any vessel I knew. ...The FUTURE?! That old castle had seemed to belong to our present, or the past. But this ship suggested a world a little ahead of my time. A few years? A few decades? If that was true, wonderful. Proof that humanity had not been destroyed by that 'god'—◆but was it really the future? For all I knew, we could be thrown into a future that could never actually happen. This situation had already left my understanding far behind.
en.text:
I looked down. Only then did I realize: no land below us. Sea.

The water was raging as badly as the sky. A ship, not a very large one, drifted on it.◆

A ship…………◆A ship?

A ship, yes. But of what kind? I had never seen one shaped like that.

More refined, more advanced in construction than any vessel I knew.

...The FUTURE?!

That old castle had seemed to belong to our present, or the past. But this ship suggested a world a little ahead of my time. A few years? A few decades?

If that was true, wonderful. Proof that humanity had not been destroyed by that 'god'—◆but was it really the future? For all I knew, we could be thrown into a future that could never actually happen.

This situation had already left my understanding far behind.

ja.html: 目をやる。 　そうして初めて気付いたが、下にあるのは陸地では なく海だった。 　空に負けず荒れ狂っている海面を、さほど大きくも ない船が漂っている。◆ 　 　船…………◆船？ 　船には違いない。 　だが、あのような形状の船は見たことがない。 　俺の知るどんな船舶より、洗練された――先進的な 構造をしている。 　 　……ここは、未来か!? 　先刻の古城は現在ないし過去と思えたが。 　あの船から推し量るに、この時空間は俺の時代より やや――数年か数十年か――時間の進んでいる世界と 思しい。 　真実そうなら、何よりの事だ。 　人類世界が〝神〟に滅ぼされなかったという証左に なる――◆が、本当に未来なのかは知れたものではない し、有り得ない未来・・・・・・・に飛ぶ事もあるかもしれない。 　現状は既に俺の理解を脱しているのだ。
ja.text:
目をやる。
　そうして初めて気付いたが、下にあるのは陸地では
なく海だった。

　空に負けず荒れ狂っている海面を、さほど大きくも
ない船が漂っている。◆
　
　船…………◆船？

　船には違いない。
　だが、あのような形状の船は見たことがない。

　俺の知るどんな船舶より、洗練された――先進的な
構造をしている。
　
　……ここは、未来か!?

　先刻の古城は現在ないし過去と思えたが。
　あの船から推し量るに、この時空間は俺の時代より
やや――数年か数十年か――時間の進んでいる世界と
思しい。

　真実そうなら、何よりの事だ。
　人類世界が〝神〟に滅ぼされなかったという証左に
なる――◆が、本当に未来なのかは知れたものではない
し、有り得ない未来・・・・・・・に飛ぶ事もあるかもしれない。

　現状は既に俺の理解を脱しているのだ。

en.html:
Probably a very good ship. Right now, no better than a little boat folded from a leaf. The waves were doing whatever they liked with it. Rescue, I ruled out. That would certainly put us right into the affairs of this world. Do not interfere. The business of this time and place belonged to its own people. I had to tell myself that and leave it alone... There was, however, another way of looking at it. Staying in this storm was also getting involved with the world, no? We could lose control while waiting and crash. Inside the ship, at least, we would be out of the wind and rain. Perhaps THAT was how to have the least possible involvement in events here...? Well? What to do?
Choices
  • Stay here.
  • Land on the ship.
en.text:
Probably a very good ship. Right now, no better than a little boat folded from a leaf. The waves were doing whatever they liked with it.

Rescue, I ruled out. That would certainly put us right into the affairs of this world.

Do not interfere. The business of this time and place belonged to its own people. I had to tell myself that and leave it alone...

There was, however, another way of looking at it.

Staying in this storm was also getting involved with the world, no? We could lose control while waiting and crash.

Inside the ship, at least, we would be out of the wind and rain. Perhaps THAT was how to have the least possible involvement in events here...?

Well? What to do?

Choices
• Stay here.
• Land on the ship.

ja.html:
優れた船なのだろうが、今は笹船と変わらない。 　波の暴虐にただ弄ばれている。 　助ける、という選択は脳内から排除した。 　それは確実に、この世界への深い関与となるだろう。 　手を出すべきではない。 　この時空間の事はこの時空間の人間の預かりだと、 思い捨てるしかない……。 　だが、別の観点からの考えもあった。 　暴風雨の中に留まること自体、この世界との関わり だと言えばそうだ。 　待っている間に姿勢制御を失い、墜落する可能性も ある。 　あの船の中に入れば、ひとまず雨風は凌げるだろう。 　あるいはそれが、最もこの時空間の事象と関わりを 持たなくて済む方法か……？ 　さて、どうする。
選択肢
  • ここに留まる
  • 船上に降りる
ja.text:
優れた船なのだろうが、今は笹船と変わらない。
　波の暴虐にただ弄ばれている。

　助ける、という選択は脳内から排除した。
　それは確実に、この世界への深い関与となるだろう。

　手を出すべきではない。
　この時空間の事はこの時空間の人間の預かりだと、
思い捨てるしかない……。

　だが、別の観点からの考えもあった。

　暴風雨の中に留まること自体、この世界との関わり
だと言えばそうだ。
　待っている間に姿勢制御を失い、墜落する可能性も
ある。

　あの船の中に入れば、ひとまず雨風は凌げるだろう。
　あるいはそれが、最もこの時空間の事象と関わりを
持たなくて済む方法か……？

　さて、どうする。

• 船上に降りる
